static_traits.name: Lin Lei
static_traits.social_status: 与部分朋友的关系因自卑与比较而紧张；有一位支持性的室友，但尚not yet向其敞开关于羞耻的感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好、合作度高；能够自我Reflection并愿意练习现实检验与重构；对他人评价较为敏感，带有“应该”式自我要求

basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己的兼职工作感到羞耻，认为自己应该拥有更符合skill且薪酬更高的工作。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of shame are affecting my self-esteem and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: 约一年前完成学业后，Lin Lei在求职中长期not yet能获得全职岗位，由此开始产生明显的羞耻感；每当看到招聘信息或听到朋友的职业进展时，这些羞耻与Self-denial进一步被激活。
在过去一年里经常与同龄人进行比较，将自身职业进展与他人对照，逐步形成“自己落后、not如人”的体验，导致与部分朋友Relationship tension，并影响日常自我照顾与动力。

core_beliefs: I am a failure/not够有价值
我的价值取决于工作成就和收入

special_situations.event: 看到与自身skill相关且薪资更高的招聘信息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not获得与skill匹配且薪酬更高的全职工作，就证明我在浪费潜力并且是失败的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases resume submissions, seeks career guidance online; at the same time avoids talking to others about true feelings to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在浪费潜力，我毫without进展

special_situations.event: 听到朋友的职业晋升或薪酬提升的消息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同龄人走在前面而我have not同等成就，就说明我not如他们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与这些朋友的互动、Reduced socializing接触；用更多时间刷职位信息与比较他人履历

special_situations.event: 考虑向室友或朋友寻求反馈/分享羞耻感受
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果暴露自己的not足，就会被看not起或被负面评价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持沉默，避免自我暴露与求助，以降低被评判的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看not起我、会评判我

special_situations.event: 回想完成学业后长期not yet能找到全职工作的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在关键阶段not达成目标，就意味着我永远会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Drives more job-seeking action with self-criticism, but ignores the positive side of the current job to 'spur oneself'

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与肯定自己的能力与价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判、被羞辱，或被视为失败者
defense_goal: 通过回避自我暴露来避免被评判
通过追求更“体面”的工作来证明自我价值、缓解without价值感

object_relations.self_representation: 落后且not够成功的人、容易被negate的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者（同龄人/社会/潜在听众）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询聚焦于向他人寻求反馈或与室友坦诚分享感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身严苛的自我批评与negate投向他人，体验为“do not人会看not起我/会评判我”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、without评判地澄清与验证，邀请举具体证据与替代解释；正常化羞耻体验，缓慢探询其担心被评价的具体图景。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到职业成就与“是否有意义”时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向以理性分析谈论经历，弱化羞耻与脆弱情绪的表达
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing the pace, using reflection of feelings and present-experience-oriented questions ('where in your body do you feel it most right now?') to help bring the emotions in the narrative back to the present.

manifestations: 认为自己“在浪费潜力、have not实现任何有意义的成就”
将职业与收入作为意义与价值的核心衡量
outcomes: Decreased drive与自我照顾受影响

manifestations: 担心被评判而not向室友或朋友敞开羞耻感受
与部分朋友关系因自卑与比较而紧张
outcomes: The support system has difficulty functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁以“应该有更体面/高薪的工作”要求自己
将社会/同龄人的职业标准当作自身价值的唯一标尺

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 担心被评判而Suppressing expression羞耻与需要
在分享与求助上过度谨慎，限制与支持者的接触

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将自身的Self-denial体验解读为“do not人会看not起我”
在社交中预设他人持负面看法从而避免接触

positive_force: 有支持性的室友可提供情感与现实支持
具备求助动机并愿意练习现实检验与重构
能识do not并承认当下工作的积极面（支付账单、积累经验）
持续投递简历并主动在线寻求职业指导
negative_force: 频繁社会比较，易引发自卑与羞耻
将自我价值高度绑定于职业成就与收入
心理过滤与negate积极导致自我Reinforcement的失败感
对他人评判的担忧（读心式Anticipation）限制求助
自我照顾下降，加重Low mood与Insufficient motivation

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贬低与羞耻的自动思维（如“我在浪费潜力”“我have not任何有意义的成就”）
antecedent: 回想完成学业后not yet获全职工作的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值等同于职业成就与收入，并进行高频社会比较
target_behavior.function: Maintains an illusion of 'spurring on' and control through self-criticism, while avoiding positive evidence to maintain cognitive consistency
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Decreased drive、工作满意度与绩效下降

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向室友/朋友披露感受与寻求支持
antecedent: 想到与他人谈及羞耻与not足
被建议寻求外界反馈时
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被评判/羞辱，将内在Self-denial投向他人的Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在负面评价以短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、The support system has difficulty functioning、Loneliness与羞耻维持

target_behavior.behavior: 自我照顾与日常规律下降（如动机not足、例行护理减少）
antecedent: 在比较与失败感被激活后
target_behavior.core_reason: 羞耻与Self-denial导致行为激活降低与回避
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪与精力进一步下降，形成负性循环
